implementation_recommendation.root_invariant: Current.Arguments keeps closure/table/length/all copied actual arguments until existing Function_Value Start returns. Separate owned arg-only vector remains backed by those traced values. Start Begin_Operation does not clear Current.Arguments; Dispatch pins callee/args before new-frame publication. Only after successful Start clear host packet, avoiding stale roots before call hook/script. On failure cancel before dropping host roots.
implementation_recommendation.capacity: Pre-reserve Current.Arguments metadata+Minimum_C_Stack and separate owned arg arena Minimum_C_Stack before callbacks. Take_Results preserves fitting target capacity through existing Transfer_Result_Ownership. Reserve final n while full root packet remains; precharge copying/clear work and keep actual owner accounting/refusal.
implementation_recommendation.no_early_clear: Do not trim closure prefix and rely on a local Value, a local untraced vector, or temporary Operation_Roots pins across Start.
